newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.018pts to 103.183.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.018pts to 103.183.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.018 points in Wednesday's trading to 103.183, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.232 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.045 points to 99.498, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.171 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.808 points to 1,035.571.
